summary: Referrals module end-to-end testing. 17/17 backend pytest tests pass covering /me, /customers, /commissions, /payouts, /bank-account (POST+GET), /public/resolve/{code}, signup attribution, invalid-code silent ignore, self-referral block, Stripe invoice.paid 15% commission accrual, idempotency on duplicate stripe_invoice_id, and customer.subscription.deleted → status=cancelled. Frontend Referrals page renders correctly, copy button + all 4 stat tiles + 5 tabs work, bank form saves successfully and toast shows. /r/<valid-code> redirects to /signup?ref=<code> and ref banner renders. Paywall bypass on /app/referrals works (no overlay rendered on this route).

ui_bugs.issue: Banner shows the raw referral CODE ('Referred by acme-dental-clinic-60afb5') instead of the referrer's business name ('Acme Dental Clinic'). The /api/referrals/public/resolve/{code} endpoint correctly returns referrer_business_name but the signup page does not appear to be using it (or call fails silently). Backend resolve endpoint verified working.
Expected data-testid='payouts-empty' element is NOT present when payouts list is empty (count=0). Other empty-state markers like customers-empty should also be verified.

integration_issues.issue: When the trial paywall overlay is active (e.g., on /app Overview), the full-screen paywall-overlay (fixed inset-0 z-50) intercepts pointer events on the sidebar, so a paywalled user CANNOT click the 'Referrals' nav link to reach the page — they can only get to /app/referrals via direct URL or browser refresh. PaywallGuard correctly bypasses the overlay ONCE the user is already on /app/referrals, but the entry path via sidebar click is blocked. Fix: either lower overlay z-index relative to sidebar, OR have PaywallGuard render the overlay only inside the main content area (not fixed inset-0), OR let the overlay ignore pointer events on the sidebar region.

Invalid referral codes still redirect to /signup?ref=<invalid>. Consider validating via /api/referrals/public/resolve/{code} before redirect — if invalid, either drop the ref param or redirect to /signup without ref. Today the signup page would display 'Referred by <invalid-code>' which is misleading.

action_items: Signup.jsx: when ?ref=<code> is present, call GET /api/referrals/public/resolve/{code} and render banner text using referrer_business_name (not the raw code). If valid=false, hide banner (or show generic) and avoid attributing on submit.
Add data-testid='payouts-empty' to the empty-state element on the Payouts tab (and confirm customers-empty exists too).

Fix paywall overlay vs. sidebar interaction so a paywalled vendor can actually click the Referrals nav link. Either render paywall overlay only over the <main> area, give the sidebar a higher z-index than the overlay, OR make the overlay pointer-events:none on the sidebar region.
ReferralRedirect.jsx: optionally validate the code server-side before redirecting; if invalid, redirect to /signup with no ref param so the misleading 'Referred by <bad-code>' banner is never shown.
critical_code_review_comments: referral_routes.py L82: resolve_referrer_by_code lowercases input — good. attach_referral_on_signup also lowercases. Codes stored lowercase. Consistent.
referral_routes.py L160-163: commission_amount = round(payment_amount_usd * 0.15, 2) — for $49 produces 7.35 (verified). Edge case: rounding bias on penny-level invoices is acceptable.
referral_routes.py L143-148: only credits if referrals row has status='active' — correct, prevents commissions accruing after cancellation.

referral_routes.py L149-155: idempotency keyed on stripe_invoice_id — verified by test_invoice_paid_is_idempotent. Good. However a blank invoice_id ('' string) would bypass dedup; if Stripe ever sends a paid invoice without id this could double-credit. Consider rejecting empty invoice_id outright.
server.py L3559-3563: amount selection prefers subtotal_excluding_tax → falls back to subtotal → amount_paid. Good defensive ordering so HST/VAT isn't commissioned out.
server.py L568-572: referral attribution wrapped in try/except, never raises — signup never fails because of a bad referral code. Matches the 'silently ignored' spec.

Self-referral IP defense (referral_routes.py L110-111): only triggers when BOTH IPs are non-empty AND match. In dev/preview behind ingress, every signup carries the ingress IP — could mis-block legitimate referrals if behind shared NAT. Already mitigated by 'both must be non-empty', but worth flagging once you turn on x-forwarded-for trust in production.
PaywallGuard bypass list should be confirmed to include exactly /app/referrals — verified in browser: paywall-overlay count = 0 on /app/referrals.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (page renders, tabs work, bank save works, /r/ redirect works; ref-banner shows code not business name + sidebar nav blocked under paywall)

test_credentials: demo@botnira.com / demo123 (referrer in tests). Brand-new vendors created with TEST_ prefix via /api/auth/signup using demo's referral code.
seed_data_creation: Tests create (a) two TEST_-prefixed referred vendors via signup, (b) attach stripe_subscription_id directly via Mongo to one of them so the invoice.paid webhook can match, (c) two referral_commissions rows (one $49, one $29) and a TEST bank account row for demo vendor. All tagged 'TEST_' for cleanup.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET IS set in .env (whsec_mPK1LkadeGrrw29ZxTB1yNCsomMDRcdB), contrary to the review_request which said it was unset — the test helper _post_stripe_webhook computes the v1 HMAC signature.
